mobbin:e8c931f2-dc00-4c3f-9b4f-50b11564a.summary: Admin opens Dashboards, creates a named private dashboard with viewers/editors, then lands on an empty two-column canvas beside a searchable Add a Gadget library of 31 items.
steps: Dashboards list — Default dashboard + Create dashboard
Create modal — Asset Storage + Private viewers/editors
Empty two-column canvas + Add a Gadget sidebar (31)
steal: Empty-column placeholders: Drag a gadget or add a new gadget (step 3) — clear first paint after create.
Gadget library with search + category counts (All/Jira/Charts/Wallboard) and Add per item (step 3).
Edit-mode banner: changes saved automatically + Done (step 3) — low-risk layout editing.
avoid: Create-your-own dashboard + 31-gadget library + separate Viewers/Editors ACLs (steps 0–3) — over-built for non-technical faculty (40–60); leadership asked for widgets, not a gadget OS.
mobbin:e8c931f2-dc00-4c3f-9b4f-50b11564a.fit: Counterweight to deferred role-widget layer: steal curated defaults and empty placeholders for the dashboard only; do not ship a free-form gadget library—Reports/Debrief/Scheduling content should be fixed cards that hand off into those modules.

mobbin:58df3be1-dd99-487a-83db-b759ced61.summary: Admin configures the Default dashboard affecting all users, opens Change layout column presets, and expands to a three-column grid with an empty gadget slot.
steps: Configure Default dashboard — Intro / Assigned to Me / Projects / Activity
Change layout menu — five column presets
Three-column layout — empty third column placeholder
steal: Admin Default dashboard warning: changes affect all users (steps 0–2) — role/org defaults without per-faculty gadget DIY.
Change layout as 5 icon presets (1 / 50-50 / 33-66 / 3-col…) (steps 1–2) — simple layout choice.
Assigned to Me list on the default home (step 0) — action-items card that can hand off into Debrief/grading work.
avoid: Per-gadget chrome (drag, minimize, expand, refresh, …) plus deep System admin IA (steps 0–2) — too much machinery for faculty; keep rearrange optional, library tiny.
mobbin:58df3be1-dd99-487a-83db-b759ced61.fit: Good model for admin-set role defaults on the dashboard (phase-2 widgets) with Assigned-to-Me → Debrief/action-items; avoid exposing full layout machinery to faculty end users.
